story_review.reviewer_identity: storyboard-critic claude-opus-5-5 high, isolated phone comparison assignment (packet round 7)
story_review.one_viewing_summary: A driverless white car arrives at a San Antonio airport curb and a phone says Arriving. A map shows the earlier 60 square mile area from February. Two disclosed illustrated cars sit in floodwater, then a federal recall card counts the cars and is stamped. A car slows and rolls into standing water under the recall sentence with 'may' highlighted. The remedy row is stamped under development, a fleet takes interim checks by April 20, and the airport ride ends beside the open remedy card.
story_review.opening_to_ending: The opening asks what the federal record says once anyone can hail the car. The ending holds the open-door airport ride beside 'The remedy is currently under development.' The question is answered within the source limit and no outcome is invented. The closing water plate muddies the image.
story_review.weakest_transition: s6 to s7 (36.9-41.6 s): from the hero water entry to the record close, where the decisive stamp is then hidden under the pen and bar.
blocking_defects: s3 swept action and empty cabin not shown
rectangular water panels in s3, s4 and s6
s7 stamp consequence occluded by a bodiless bar and pen
closing frame's water plate under the airport curb

notes: Source and disclosures read correctly on screen: 'Illustration. A different car, April 20th account', 'Another car, earlier in April', 'The recall wording, not a recorded event', 'A generic airport ride, not the flood cars'. On-screen numerals (60, 3,791, 3,800, 20, April 20th, 2026) appear in the fetched quotes of c2, c6, c13 and c12. No retired motifs. The flag is the Lone Star.
